english: 「Combat area scanned. Enemy forces confirmed.\nInitiating combat.」
「Not that I am interested in destruction.\nIt is my mission.」
「Judged to be the same model type.」
「Two of the same AI are unnecessary.」
「Your will is unrelated to my mission.」
「A mass-produced model cannot beat the original.」
「I... have no duty to obey you.」
「Adjusting firepower... next time I will surely exterminate you.」
「I am often told I lack playfulness.」
「Mission complete. Moving to next combat zone.」
「Damage at this level: combat continuation judged possible.」
「At this rate, the mission will be compromised...」
「I can also use this kind of attack.」
